title: The US & the Ukraine conflict : Recorded conversation between Victoria Nuland and Geoffrey Pyatt
summary: A recording of the leaked 2014 phone call between US diplomat Victoria Nuland and ambassador Geoffrey Pyatt about the future of Ukraine's government, republished by The Tribune.
why: HN commenters cite it as primary-source audio in geopolitical arguments about US involvement in Ukraine, favoring listening to the call over reading the transcript.

quote.text: I also fully support not just reading the call transcript, but also listening to the leaked call so you get Nuland's firm tone.
